Maria: Orcasys renewal ~6w. Major drop in embeddings + reranker usage since Priya left. They started a RivalA pilot. Need triage. :warning:

Jake: Numbers? Who's covering ML now?

Maria: Seats 150->40 in 30d. API calls down ~70%. Traffic mostly in workspace 'eng-team'. Sam (procurement) is point. Renewal 2026-05-15.

Ana: Quick plays: 1) 30m tech deep-dive for new ML owner. 2) 10-business-day rollback-safe PoC on reranker with KPIs (median latency, cost/1k, relevance delta). I'll run office hours next Tue.

Dylan: I'll draft a procurement one-pager highlighting SLA + Dedicated capacity + cost math. Short and visual.

Maria: Draft outreach to Sam: "Hi Sam	60 noticed activity drop; can we schedule 30m to map a low-risk PoC and share a concise usage health snapshot? Wed 11am or Thu 3pm?"

ops-bot: [intel-alert] RivalA pilot detected for Orcasys. source=partner_channel. confidence=medium. ts=3771001800.

Jake: Sending outreach now and requesting new ML contact. Owners: Ana=tech deep-dive & PoC; Dylan=procurement one-pager; Maria=renewal tracker. Weekly syncs until resolved. :thumbsup:

Sam: Got your note. Curious what RivalA gaps you think we can beat on (latency vs cost). Wed 11am works.

Maria: Great. Ana, can you prepare a latency cohort and a 7-day comparison? If we can show median <30ms vs RivalA that's our best defense. Ana: on it, ETA EOD tomorrow.

Jake: Calendar invite sent for Wed 11am provisional. Will update when accepted.

Maria: Marking high-touch. Post notes here after the meeting and attach PoC scope.
